title: Freeman Dyson on IDA advisory board
place_text: Institute for Defense Analysis, Center for Communications Research, New Jersey

tellings.quote: where I worked a member of The Advisory board for that place that I worked Freeman Dyson was on it

plain: A man named Bob Maguire says the physicist Freeman Dyson sat on the advisory board of the place where he worked: the Center for Communications Research, a research centre run by the Institute for Defense Analysis in New Jersey. Maguire tells Michels this from his own working life, in passing, as a mark of the kind of minds that were around him there.
